newsitem.title: USA: Motorola files more claims against Qualcomm.
newsitem.headline: Motorola files more claims against Qualcomm.

text.p: Motorola Inc said it filed seven more patent infringement claims against Qualcomm Inc.
Motorola filed the claims in a federal court in San Diego, it said. The claims relate to features for Motorola's paging products and Qualcomm's CDMA phones, the company added.
Motorola said it filed the claims as a separate lawsuit against Qualcomm, although they may be consolidated with any of the previous pending lawsuits between the companies.
The suit is the latest in an ongoing patent infringement battle between the companies.
In March, Motorola filed a suit against Qualcomm alleging Qualcomm's Q-phone copies the design of Motorola's StarTAC digital cellular phone.
Motorola seeks to have Qualcomm permanently enjoined from further infringement of the patents, it said, and to recover damages.
Qualcomm, in a separate statement, said it did not believe its phone products infringed on any of Motorola's patents.
Qualcomm said the new claims by Motorola include non-CDMA pager patents.
In early August, Qualcomm sued Motorola, alleging that a Motorola senior engineer stole the upper half of the housing for Qualcomm's Q-phone from a supplier before the Q-phone was publicly announced.
